data.description:
## Description

What: Enable the Require CodeQL and Require code-quality ruleset rules on the DSO repo by running provision-ruleset.sh with require_codeql=true and require_code_quality=true, then verify in-session via gh api that the rules are present and enforced on main, the code-scanning API is live, and at least one sprint PR is gated by the new rules (self-use). Why: Satisfies sc-4 (rules enabled, matching the 2026-04-28 manual adjustments) and the cc-2 self-use invariant. Scope IN: ruleset enablement on this repo, the Probe-6 external-dependency gh-CLI checks (presence, ref scoping, API live), and the cc-2 sprint-PR-gated verification. Scope OUT: the synthetic-finding gating demonstration (draft-5), the knob implementation (draft-3), the CI jobs (draft-1/draft-2).


## Done Definitions

- The repo's GitHub Ruleset has the Require CodeQL and Require code-quality (code_scanning-type) rules enabled, enforced on the default branch ← Satisfies: sc-4 ← Validates Closure Check: "**SC (self-use, Probe-1 remediation, architecture-vs-evidence audit 2026-05-16):** Before the 88d2 sprint can be marked complete, the new `require_codeql` and `require_code_quality` GitHub Ruleset rules are enabled on the DSO repo, AND at least one sprint PR is gated by the new rules."
- The code-scanning API responds successfully for the repo (Probe-6 liveness) ← Satisfies: sc-4
- At least one sprint PR shows BOTH a CodeQL-tool check run AND a code-quality-tool check run participating in the merge gate (not either-or), confirming both rules gate self-use ← Validates Closure Check: "**SC (self-use, Probe-1 remediation, architecture-vs-evidence audit 2026-05-16):** Before the 88d2 sprint can be marked complete, the new `require_codeql` and `require_code_quality` GitHub Ruleset rules are enabled on the DSO repo, AND at least one sprint PR is gated by the new rules."

## Considerations

- [Risk] Enabling these rules before the CI jobs emit data would permanently block PRs — depends_on draft-1, draft-2, and draft-3 is load-bearing, not cosmetic.
- [External dependency] Probe-6 ref-scoping check requires the ruleset conditions to include ~DEFAULT_BRANCH; verify before declaring the rule enforced.
- [Risk] Before flipping require_codeql/require_code_quality to true, confirm that the draft-1 and draft-2 jobs produced a successful, non-flaky analysis on a fresh PR AND that the ruleset required-check identity (tool name / category) exactly matches what those jobs upload. Flipping the rules on while a job is flaky, mis-categorized, or skipped permanently blocks all PRs — including the recovery fix PR that would correct it. (red/blue accepted finding 4, consumer_impact / anti-stranding gate)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want the Require CodeQL and Require code-quality rules enabled on this repo and gating a sprint PR, so that the scanning gates are live and self-used.
